clue.text: Aquatic legend — she controls men's swimming

indicators.note: letters that are swimming are moving about loosely, so the fodder's letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman is in charge of the men's swimming team, a legend of the pool.
explanation.walkthrough: The fifteen letters of 'she controls men's', apostrophe dropped, are rearranged; 'Aquatic legend' at the front looked like it described a swimmer.
explanation.definitionFit: Nessie is the mythical creature said to live in a Scottish loch, a legend of the water.

clue.text: Joan's partner vocally supporting pub's closely contested fixture?

indicators.note: in a down answer the piece supporting another sits beneath it, so this one comes second

parts.note: a local is the pub nearest your home, the one you frequent

indicators.note: spoken aloud, the name of Joan's partner gives a word spelt differently

parts.note: Darby and Joan are the proverbial devoted old married couple

explanation.surface: A pub that backs its team at the big game against the neighbours.
explanation.walkthrough: In British speech DERBY is said 'darby', so it sounds like Joan's partner. A local derby is a match between two teams from the same area; the question mark marks 'closely contested' as a pun on geographical closeness.
explanation.definitionFit: A game between near neighbours is close in distance as well as, often, in score: a play on two senses of close.

clue.text: Back row reach down somehow

indicators.note: somehow means in some way or other, so the letters are put together in another order

explanation.surface: An instruction to a player stretching down from the back row of a team photo.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a term from draughts (checkers): a piece that reaches the opponent's back row is crowned, so that row is called the crown-head.
explanation.definitionFit: In draughts the furthest rank of the board, where pieces become kings, is known by this name.

clue.text: Film doctor and nurse then go private

parts.note: Dr No is the first James Bond film, named for its villain
EN is an enrolled nurse
to have a go is to try

explanation.surface: A film's doctor and nurse decide to go into private practice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Film doctor' gives the doctor's surname only, from the title Dr No.
explanation.definitionFit: A sign saying this marks an area as closed to the public, the same message as a sign reading Private.

clue.text: That is the end of Sumo wrestling — champion Hakuho falls outside ring initially

indicators.note: wrestling bodies twist and tangle, so the letters of the sport's name are rearranged
initially means at the start, so the first letter of each of the five words is taken

explanation.surface: A sumo champion tumbles out of the ring, ending the sport for him.
explanation.walkthrough: Hakuho is a celebrated Japanese sumo grand champion, which makes the surface ring true. Rearrange SUMO to SOMU, then take the first letters of 'champion Hakuho falls outside ring'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom dismissing something as finished or failed, as in 'so much for that plan'.

clue.text: Fruit Tongan farms regularly served up

indicators.note: in a down answer something served up is brought upwards, so the letters read from bottom to top
regularly means at even intervals, so every second letter is taken

explanation.surface: Produce from Tongan farms is put on the table.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of 'Tongan farms' are O, G, N, A, M; 'served up' turns them round.
explanation.definitionFit: This tropical stone fruit with orange flesh is a plausible crop for a Pacific island.

clue.text: Michael Jackson song climbing July charts essentially — it's to do with star association

definitions.text: it's to do with star association

indicators.note: in a down answer climbing means going up, so the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: Ben was Michael Jackson's 1972 hit about a rat

indicators.note: essentially points to the essence, the inner core, so the middle letters of each word are taken

explanation.surface: A Michael Jackson single climbs the July charts, which is all about his status as a star.
explanation.walkthrough: Ben reversed gives NEB; the middles of July and charts are UL and AR.
explanation.definitionFit: A nebula is a cloud of gas and dust where stars gather or form, so the adjective relates to such a stellar grouping.

clue.text: Criminal attacks middle of fort — soldiers potentially rest here

indicators.note: criminal suggests something crooked or bent, so the letters are rearranged
the middle two letters of a four-letter word are taken

explanation.surface: A criminal raids the centre of a fort, where soldiers might be resting.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain soldiers are also thin strips of toast for dipping in a boiled egg, which is the trick in the definition. Mix ATTACKS with OR, the middle of fort.
explanation.definitionFit: Slices of toast cut into fingers, called soldiers, can stand in the rack that holds toast upright at breakfast.

clue.text: See 7
King married old woman

parts.note: CR is Carolus Rex, King Charles, as seen on a royal cipher
a married couple become one, united

explanation.surface: A king weds an elderly woman.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a somewhat insulting term for a withered elderly lady, often a witch in fairy tales.

clue.text: No Trumps involved in Mafia family caught moving luxury goods brand

indicators.note: involved in means wrapped up in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: the mob is organised crime, the Mafia
NT is the bridge abbreviation for no trumps

indicators.note: moving tells us the letter for caught shifts its position within the word for family

parts.note: a clan is an extended family
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A Mafia family smuggling designer goods, with nobody holding the trump cards.
explanation.walkthrough: The C of CLAN moves from the front to the end, giving LANC.
explanation.definitionFit: This company sells upmarket pens, watches and leather accessories, named after the Alpine peak.

clue.text: Short breather before a dictator's second fruitcake

indicators.note: before puts the first piece ahead of the rest
short means lacking the final letter

parts.note: a lung is the organ we breathe with

indicators.note: a dictator here is one who dictates, speaking aloud, so the word for second is given as it sounds

parts.note: a tick is a moment, a second

explanation.surface: A dictator pauses briefly to take a breath before his next move, then is called a nutcase.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dictator' is not a tyrant but someone dictating words aloud, so TICK becomes its sound-alike TIC. Fruitcake is slang for a crazy person, from the phrase 'nutty as a fruitcake'.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruitcake is informal slang for a mad or eccentric person, the same meaning as a madman.

clue.text: Perhaps green's smooth for golf tour recently

indicators.note: one word standing in for another means it replaces it

parts.note: olive is one shade of green, hence 'perhaps'
LIV is the Saudi-backed breakaway professional golf tour
flat means smooth and level

explanation.surface: A golf green is being made smooth for the professional tour these days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Green' looks like a golf putting green, but it is the colour olive; swap its LIV for FLAT.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a slightly formal way of saying lately, in the period just past.

clue.text: A 10/1 gamble on the outside — nudged into second place?

indicators.note: the word for gamble goes on the outside, around the other pieces

parts.note: a bet is a gamble
the betting odds 10/1 are said as ten to one, with I as the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A punter puts a long-odds bet on an outsider, which is pipped at the post into second.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a cryptic sense: if someone beat you to it, you came second in the race to do something.
explanation.definitionFit: When someone gets there before you, you are forestalled and relegated to runner-up, as when narrowly outrun in a race.

clue.text: Engineers returned with unknown mineral

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the letters are read in reverse order

parts.note: REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British Army corps
Y is one of the algebraic unknowns

explanation.surface: Army engineers come back carrying an unidentified mineral sample.
explanation.definitionFit: This rock containing corundum is ground for abrasives, as on nail boards and sandpaper.

clue.text: Glow of pipe, crack-smoker occasionally managed to get inside

indicators.note: to get inside means to enter, so these letters go within the word for pipe

parts.note: a flue is a pipe or duct for smoke

indicators.note: managed means handled and arranged, so the chosen letters are rearranged
occasionally means now and then, so every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: The glow of a crack pipe, as a user sometimes manages to get the drug inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Managed' reads as succeeded in the surface, but here it means handled, arranging the alternate letters before they go inside the pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: To give off light after absorbing radiation, as a highlighter pen does under ultraviolet, is to shine or emit radiance.

clue.text: Model runs my bath — she's first to be stripped — it's not true but plenty of people believe it

definitions.text: it's not true but plenty of people believe it

indicators.note: to model clay is to reshape it, so the letters are put into a new form
stripped means removed, so that letter is taken out of the fodder
the first letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A model's bath is run for her, and she gets undressed first.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the S (first of 'she's') out of RUNS MY BATH and rearrange the remaining nine letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A widely circulated modern story or belief that is false, passed on as fact by many.

clue.text: Horoscope's focus with respect to third of zodiac given sudden emphasis

indicators.note: the focus is the central point, so the middle letter of the nine-letter word is taken

parts.note: the word horoscope itself, its possessive ending set aside
for can mean regarding, as in 'so much for that'
the first third of the six-letter word zodiac is Z and O, written out in full as a phrase

explanation.surface: A horoscope dwells on the third sign of the zodiac with dramatic force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Third of zodiac' looks like Gemini, the third sign, but it is the letters Z and O, a third of the word, spelt out with the AND.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning a note or chord is to be played with a sudden strong accent.

clue.text: Group abandon beauty treatment

parts.note: a body is an organised group, such as a professional body
to scrub a plan is to drop or cancel it

explanation.surface: An organisation calls off its spa day.
explanation.definitionFit: An exfoliating product rubbed over the skin, a pampering session offered at spas and salons.

clue.text: Then USA manipulated butter producer

indicators.note: manipulated means handled and worked into shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: America then rigged the butter market.
explanation.definitionFit: The fruit of the African shea tree yields a fat used in cosmetics and cooking, called shea butter.

clue.text: 150 and on strike, demonstrating power

parts.note: CL is the Roman numeral for 150
workers on strike are out

explanation.surface: A hundred and fifty workers walk out to show their strength.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means influence or leverage, as in political pull, as well as a heavy blow.

clue.text: Understand cannula must be emptied — start to turn both taps round periodically

indicators.note: emptied means the inside is removed, so only the first and last letters remain
the start of a word is its first letter

parts.note: C and H, the cold and hot taps

indicators.note: periodically means at intervals, so alternate letters are taken

explanation.surface: A medical instruction: drain the cannula, then turn both taps round now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of 'round' are O and N.
explanation.definitionFit: To grasp an idea, finally seeing what is meant, is a phrasal verb also meaning to become popular.

clue.text: Maybe Corbyn's embracing Labour's leader — they might have clenched teeth

indicators.note: embracing means hugging, so the word goes around the other letter

parts.note: Piers Corbyn, a weather forecaster, is the brother of former Labour leader Jeremy Corbyn; 'maybe' shows he is one of several Corbyns

indicators.note: the leader is the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Jeremy Corbyn, presumably, hugging Labour's leader through gritted teeth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Corbyn' makes you think of Jeremy, the former Labour leader, but it is his brother Piers.
explanation.definitionFit: The jaws of this gripping tool have serrated edges, like teeth, that clamp shut.

clue.text: See 25
Way to make moonshine quietly

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a distilling apparatus used for illicit spirits
second meaning: calmly, without movement or noise

explanation.walkthrough: Moonshine is illegally distilled liquor, not moonlight.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a distilling device and also works as an adverb meaning silently or motionlessly.

clue.text: Regular surfer to catch current with calm state of mind

parts.note: to net a fish is to catch it
I is the physics symbol for electric current
Zen is the meditative calm of Buddhist practice

explanation.surface: A surfer waits to catch a wave, calm as a Buddhist monk.
explanation.walkthrough: The surfer is not on waves but on the internet.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who spends much time online, browsing web pages, is a citizen of the internet.

clue.text: Cliff's content to come back before Wimbledon's centrepiece match — it means we see less of The Shadows

definitions.text: it means we see less of The Shadows

indicators.note: to come back means to return, so those letters read in reverse
the content of a word is what is held inside it, so the outer letters are removed

parts.note: the name Cliff itself, its possessive ending set aside

indicators.note: the centrepiece is the middle, so the central letter of the nine-letter word is taken

parts.note: the word Wimbledon itself, its possessive ending set aside
a match is used to light a fire

explanation.surface: Cliff Richard returning for a match at Wimbledon, leaving his old backing group, the Shadows, in the background.
explanation.walkthrough: Cliff Richard's backing band was The Shadows, and he famously sang to the crowd during a rain delay at Wimbledon, so the surface is all about him.
explanation.definitionFit: In photography and film, a secondary lamp softens or removes the dark areas left by the main lighting.

clue.text: Singer discovered new harmony with note missing sharpness

indicators.note: discovered means with its cover taken off, so the outer letters go
missing means lacking, so that letter is taken out

parts.note: unity is harmony, agreement

explanation.surface: A singer has found a new harmony but one note is missing from it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' looks like a musical letter A to G, but here it is N, the standard abbreviation for note, taken out of UNITY.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleverness and inventiveness, a quick wit, are close to sharpness of mind.

clue.text: Bob for example, making warm and dry space for party

indicators.note: one thing put in for another replaces it

parts.note: a bob is one kind of short haircut
to air laundry is to make it warm and dry
an en is a printer's space, half an em

explanation.surface: A hairstyle that is blow-dried and given volume for a night out.
explanation.walkthrough: A hen do is the British name for a bride's party with her friends before the wedding, a bachelorette party.
explanation.definitionFit: This British informal term means a celebration for a woman about to marry, an event for her friends.

clue.text: Relax and allow independent solicitor to handle every alteration when case is dismissed

parts.note: to let is to allow

indicators.note: to handle is to hold in the hands, so the word for solicitor wraps around the rest

parts.note: a tout solicits custom, pestering people to buy
all means every one

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outer letters, so with them dismissed only the inside remains

parts.note: a change is an alteration

explanation.surface: A legal scene: let the independent solicitor deal with every change once the case is thrown out, and relax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solicitor' looks like a lawyer, but it is a tout, one who solicits trade. CHANGE with its outer letters gone is HANG.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to behave freely and without inhibition, unwinding completely.
